ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity (white) pixels to 25% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-intensity white regions occupy the central interior of both lobes; low-intensity black margins define the trailing edge, distal tips, and a vertical median column extending from the peduncle through the notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 50 degrees; vertex depth is significant relative to total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire length of the trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations ranging from 3 to 15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curvature transitioning to sharp convex sweeps at the distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white pixel clusters detected on the low-intensity black distal tips of both lobes, indicative of barnacle attachment points.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct group of small, low-intensity (dark) focal points and short linear disruptions on the mid-high-intensity region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent irregular indentation or notch on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe, located immediately to the right of the median notch vertex.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, high-contrast dark focal spot located in the lower-central region of the left fluke lobe's high-intensity zone.
